# lambda_gororoba Unified Workspace

This directory is the normalized workspace root for all lambda-related projects.

## Module map
- `modules/lambda_research` — core theory, documentation corpus, and formalization materials.
- `modules/lambda_synthesis_experiments` — Python synthesis experiments and execution artifacts.
- `modules/lambdalearner` — TypeScript/React learner interface.

## Integration contract
- Deterministic extraction and synthesis outputs are generated by:
  - `scripts/synthesize_root_layout.sh`
  - `logs/repo_integration_synthesis_<TS>.md`
  - `logs/repo_integration_matrix_<TS>.tsv`
  - `logs/conflict_matrix_<TS>.tsv`
  - `docs/REPO_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md`

## Conflict policy
- Preserve duplicate top-level files (`README`, `LICENSE`, `requirements.md`) inside each module boundary.
- Record conflict resolution decisions in `docs/CONSOLIDATION_CONFLICT_RESOLUTION.md`.
- Keep evidence and claims updated in `TODOWRITE.md` and `docs/CLAIM_REGISTER.md`.
